LightFury Games is building E-Cricket a mobile-first, AAA cricket game built on Unreal Engine 5, with the ambition to create a deeply engaging cricket experience for players globally.

Were looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager / Principal Product Manager who can take ownership of major product areas and work closely with Game Design, Engineering, UX, Art, Analytics, and Leadership to turn player needs and business goals into a great game experience.

This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys solving complex product problems, working closely with game teams, and building products where player experience, engagement, and business outcomes all matter.

What Youll Own

Own product strategy and roadmap for key areas of E-Cricket.Translate player needs, business objectives, and game vision into clear product priorities.Work closely with Game Design, Engineering, UX, Art, Analytics, and other teams to drive features from concept to launch.Define product requirements, user stories, success metrics, and acceptance criteria.Use player behaviour, product analytics, research, and feedback to identify opportunities and improve the experience.Drive prioritisation across competing product, technical, and business requirements.Partner with game designers and engineers to ensure features are both compelling for players and technically viable.Identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, progression, monetisation, and overall player experience.Establish and track meaningful product KPIs and use data to drive decisions.Take ownership of product experiments, iteration, and continuous improvement.Communicate product vision, priorities, and trade-offs clearly across teams and leadership.Help build scalable product processes as the game and organisation grow.

What Were Looking For

8+ years of product management experience, with strong experience owning consumer-facing digital products.Experience working on games, gaming platforms, entertainment products, consumer apps, or other highly engaging products is strongly preferred.Strong understanding of player/user behaviour, engagement, retention, progression, and monetisation.Proven experience taking products/features from 01 and/or scaling existing products.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into product decisions.Excellent understanding of product discovery, prioritisation, experimentation, and roadmap planning.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Ability to work effectively with highly cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly.Strong ownership mindset you identify problems, build alignment, and drive them through to execution.

For Principal Product Manager

For the Principal level, were looking for someone who can operate beyond an individual product area and help shape product strategy, systems, and direction across the broader game.

You Should Be Comfortable

Defining product strategy across multiple interconnected areas.Driving complex, cross-functional initiatives.Mentoring and influencing other Product Managers.Establishing product frameworks, metrics, and decision-making processes.Working directly with senior leadership on major product and business decisions.Balancing long-term product vision with immediate execution priorities.

Why LightFury 

At LightFury, you wont just be managing a roadmap youll be helping build a game from the ground up.

Youll have the opportunity to work with a global team building an ambitious AAA cricket experience on Unreal Engine 5, with meaningful ownership over the product and the player experience.

If youre excited by the idea of building something ambitious in gaming and want to have a direct impact on what millions of players could eventually experience, wed love to hear from you.

Interested Please send your resume with hidden_email .

About Zeta
Build the future of banking. 

Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.  

Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025. 

Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including: 

1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems 

2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments 

3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI 

4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking. 

5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024. 

6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US 

…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking. 

We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work. 

If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground. If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.
